items.doc: Mount a board inside a shadow root on host, isolated both ways: the kit can't touch the page and the page's CSS (a global button {} rule, a reset) can't touch the board. Pass the kit CSS text (e.g. import css from "board-ui/board-ui.css?raw"). Returns the .bui root to build in. Stylesheet ownership: the kit owns one constructed sheet per CSS text (keyed by the text), so games composed independently with different CSS each get their own, and boards with the same text share one. Treat it as read-only; it is appended to the shadow root's adoptedStyleSheets, never replacing sheets you adopted there yourself.

items.doc: A press that fires once per touch, mouse or keyboard activation, and never loses to a second finger already on the stick. Touch fires on touchstart (no 300ms wait); the click that may follow an uncancellable touch is skipped. Run your state change and repaint synchronously in fn: a frame between release and the new pressed state makes the key bounce.

items.doc: The press cue for page keys (.bui-key, links and buttons) under root. Mouse and touch press through CSS :active; this adds the rest: keyboard Enter (and Space on a button) shows the pressed face (.down) until the key is released or loses focus, and one passive touchstart listener lets iOS Safari apply :active at all. Activation stays native (click, navigation).

items.doc: A Settings switch: a key that is aria-pressed (the kit's locked state) while on, remembered in localStorage under key as "1" / "0". Storage that throws (private mode, blocked cookies, a sandboxed frame) is ignored: the switch still works, it just forgets. change runs once with the stored value and on every flip; set(on) flips it from code (a keyboard shortcut). Example: setting(btn, PERF_KEY, (on) => overlay.show(on), signal) with @fzlt/core/perf.

items.doc: The launch burst: the key presses into its base and flips to its inverse, then shatters into spinning chunks with a flash, a round shock ring and square debris that falls away (the hub hero's explosion). The action runs synchronously in the click (mobile full screen keeps its user activation); the burst lives on <body>, so the layout the action causes can't move it. Never cancel a burst from the action itself (see BOARD-UI.md, "reset cancels the burst").
